يبتعثا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَعِثَا (yabtaʕiṯā) /jab.ta.ʕi.θaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يُبْتَعَثَا (yubtaʕaṯā) /jub.ta.ʕa.θaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
